notes: Country determination: Germany, high certainty - EU license plate 'L KD 3455' (Leipzig prefix), German 1930s villa typology (Walmdach, clinker plinth and brick accents over roughcast stucco), EN 840 wheelie bins, green wooden garden fence typical for Saxony suburbs. Calc profile DE.

Building appears built ca. 1930s: entry door treated as historic-leaning; per DE table pre-1950 caveat, door-based chains downweighted and cross-checked against clinker brick coursing and standardized objects (IBC tote, wheelie bin, guard rail).
Brick format: dark clinker, slim stones ~240x52 mm -> classified as DF raster (course incl. joint 62.5 mm); Reichsformat (~78 mm) cannot be fully excluded, coursing reliability capped at medium.

Yaw corrections: photo 8 estimated yaw ~35 deg applied to side-wall depth chain (apparent width / cos(35)); photo 9 yaw ~55 deg, used for coursing scale only, not for widths. Photos 1/3/6 near-frontal (yaw < 8 deg), no correction applied.
Photos 4, 5 and 9 look steeply upward - vertical chains from them capped at low; heights preferred from photos 1, 3, 6.
Facade corners lie close to the frame edge in photo 1 (left corner near outer 10%); photo 3 preferred for width chains.
Site slopes down from street (front) to garden (back) by roughly 1.5 m; datum taken at front grade.
Roof ridge is short relative to footprint: side hip faces are steeper (~52 deg) than front/back faces (~41 deg); geometry kept mutually consistent with footprint.
